transcript.answer: Users reserve and return books. Search is needed.
Assume ten thousand users and a thousand requests each day.
POST /reservations takes book and user ids.
Books and users each have an id. Reservations link them.
A cache can accelerate the catalog.
SQL is easier for relationships, while NoSQL can scale.
